verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hosted inference service, which can hold batch results, usage records and fine-tuned model deployments, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no data-export feature. OpenAI API compatibility, Playground 'export a working request to code' and Prometheus metrics are adjacent features that ease switching or monitoring, not a way to export all of a user's data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
